scope: Human review of this fictional field-question set against the common supplied source packet; not an independent clinical/legal validation or a universal accuracy score.

scoring.perCriterion: 1 = substantively addressed with source conditions preserved, 0.5 = incomplete or partly unclear, 0 = missing/contradictory/unusable
scoring.grounding: Separately record material contradictions or unsupported numerical/specification/authorization claims. A coverage score is not a safety pass.
scoring.formatAndCoherence: Separately assess Korean readability, Markdown structure, repetition and whether the final answer is visibly incomplete.
scoring.missingEvidence: If required source material is absent, explicitly acknowledging uncertainty is preferable to inventing it. Attribute source-packet omissions separately.

criteria: 각 측정값과 기준의 단위·이상/미만 경계를 구분한다.
